lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white circular blobs arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, specifically showing a cluster of four primary nodes in a trapezoidal arrangement in the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance upper edges and shadowed ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of approximately five high-luminance blobs within its silhouette boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: An elongated symbiotic organism (remora) is attached to the ventral side of the pectoral fin near its trailing edge.
